Nobody breaks this rule. Everyone is safe... for now.

Rule twenty. If your country has a big desert... you get invaded.
2 countries are marked. Iraq and Yemen.
No more rules. South Korea, Eritrea, Lebanon, Ivory Coast... are left. Now they fight.
